items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: He used tincture of myrrh. That's what he gave me a bottle.

ctx.x: He used tincture of myrrh. That's what he gave me a bottle. What was that? And I had a bottle up until recently, the bottle he gave me.
Dr. Tischner's, what do they call it? Antiseptic is one of his favorites. They all use that.
Well, maybe it's the same thing.
